summary: You can export and import templates, and nobody needs standing database admin rights any more.

new.title: Export and import a template
new.text: Use Settings > Copy & tools > Export and import a template. Every imported row waits for your review in Pending changes.

fixes.title: No person needs database admin rights
fixes.text: Every installation gets its own in-network database job, kept by updates, and the setup checks report it.

fixes.title: Support database access follows your consent
fixes.text: Invardia support has read-only access, with admin rights only during an open support session and for at most 8 hours.

fixes.title: Azure roles use the longest allowed duration
fixes.text: An Azure role assignment asks for the longest duration the role's PIM policy allows at that scope.
